title: Routines
description: Scheduled task templates (cron). Each firing creates tasks that run unattended through the same safety gate.
dispatched: Routine dispatched — see the task board

empty.title: No routines
empty.description: Example: every Monday 09:00 send the weekly project status to each client.

form.gateNote: Unattended runs obey the same gate: an irreversible action pauses at an approval and notifies the owner.
form.overlap: If the previous run is still going

skip.label: Skip this run
skip.help: The firing is recorded as skipped; the next one runs on schedule.

queue.label: Queue another run
queue.help: A new run starts anyway, alongside the one still going.

preview.invalidTimezone: Unknown time zone “{timezone}”. Use an IANA name such as Asia/Jakarta.
preview.fiveFields: A rule has exactly 5 fields (minute hour day month weekday); this one has {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}.
